description: Inside the gate: a gravel lot walled in by stacked containers, a rusted reach-stacker slumped on flat tyres, and a weighbridge office the size of a phone box. Half the cans are welded shut; the other half you really don't want opened.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it is doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window
